JUDGMENT WAS DELIVERED THEREIN AS UNDER:
CORAM: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE SACHIN SHANKAR MAGADUM
ORAL JUDGMENT (PER: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE SACHIN SHANKAR MAGADUM)
The present appeal, filed under Section 74(1) of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition,
Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013, challenges the judgment and award dated 21.04.2023 in LAC No.162/2022.
Relying on precedents, including Union of India vs. Popular Construction Co. and State of Kerala vs. V.R. Kalliyanikutty1, the appeal is dismissed as time- AIR 1999 SC 1305 NC: 2024:KHC-K:10144 barred, without addressing the merits.
opennyai_summary.decision:
However, the appeal is filed after a delay of 174 days beyond the statutory limitation period of 120 days prescribed under Section 74(1) of the Act.
This Court, following the Division Bench ruling in MFA No.102543/2022 dated 23.09.2024, holds that the limitation period under the Act is mandatory and non- extendable.
Parties shall bear their respective costs.
In view of disposal of main appeal, pending applications, if any, stand rejected.
The Court fee paid, if any, shall be refunded in accordance with law.
